free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: The driver fixes torch/numpy/random seeds so repeated runs are identical; the target branch depends only on config attributes, not on the sampled values.

free_parameters.name: timeout_ms
free_parameters.why: search_one is called with a zero search budget so GradSearch.search_one does not run a forward that would overwrite check_intermediate_numeric; the target decision comes from the real differentiability probe in PracticalHybridSearch.__init__.

free_parameters.name: tensor_shape
free_parameters.why: A minimal concrete input shape for the Schedule; the target condition is a boolean config guard, so its truth value is independent of tensor shape.

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: float32 is the repository default torch dtype and makes PReLU differentiable, so PracticalHybridSearch takes the real differentiability-probe path; the guard does not inspect dtype.

free_parameters.name: schedule
free_parameters.why: A minimal real SymbolNet schedule with one trainable op (PReLU) so that forward reaches the target statement and SymbolNet's training setup has a parameter; the guard is independent of the graph.

execution.entry_reason: PracticalHybridSearch.__init__ calls the real SymbolNet.forward to test differentiability before search_one starts; that forward evaluates the target guard with the constructed attributes. search_one is still called as the official entry with a zero search budget so it does not replace the attributes or run another forward.
